commits.summary: Countermodels of the pair of versions: five false proofs of agreement, reproduced and handed to the preservation stream
Countermodels of observed class initializers and of class files the tool read where a JVM reads another: three handed to the evidence stream, two refused
The challenge stream records its evidence inbox item and a trace error the preservation stream's sync.py put on its line
Countermodels of a checked summary: seven false proofs past the foundation's refusals, refused
Countermodels of a loop invariant, found guarded; three modelled reads of an array a lemma made no refusal of, refused
Countermodels of the fresh pair of versions: a scope that writes the caller's array, and two exception classes of one name, each proved to agree
